column1: # Build targets. The container supplies the distribution; the machine supplies
# the architecture. Nothing here is emulated or cross-compiled, so a row is
# buildable only on hardware of a listed architecture.
# The arches column is load-bearing, not documentation: the official archlinux
# image publishes amd64 ONLY, so without it CI schedules an Arch leg onto an ARM
# runner and fails for a reason unrelated to the packaging. Verify before adding
# Check the distribution's toolchain too. A compiler too old to bootstrap what
# the project requires makes the target unbuildable -- Ubuntu 24.04 LTS ships Go
# 1.22, which cannot fetch a 1.27 toolchain, which is why it is absent here.
# UBI needs no Red Hat subscription and is the practical way to build for RHEL.
